content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated pay per month for the engaged positions is Rs. 60,000/- for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, Rs. 40,000/- for AYUSH Medical Officer, Rs. 20,000/- for Dietician, Rs. 28,000/- for Yoga Professional, and Rs. 15,000/- for Multi Purpose Worker (MPW). The Psychosocial Counselor is paid @ Rs. 500/- per session with at least 200 visits in a year on call basis. The recruitment is made on an outsourcing basis up to 31 March 2027, and thereafter services will continue as per need and subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sanga Reddy District Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form along with instructions from the official website of Sanga Reddy District. Fill out the application form completely and attach self-attested copies of all required certificates. Submit the filled-in application form in person or through registered post at UPHC Indira Nagar Colony near rice Godown, Ayushman Arogya Mandir Sanga Reddy HQ -502001 between 12 October 2026 and 22 October 2026 from 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years of the qualifying examination Registration certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Medical Officer Post) Registration certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post, if applicable) Latest Caste Certificate issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study certificates for the years from 4th Class to 10th Class (or residency certificate for Private Study from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned) PH certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant certificates in respect of candidates claiming Ex-serviceman quota 1 photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card

rows.details: Visit Sanga Reddy District official portal

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The recruitment is made on an outsourcing basis up to 31 March 2027, and thereafter services will continue as per need and subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Upper age relaxations are applicable as per rules: 5 years for SC, ST, and BC candidates; 3 years for ex-servicemen in addition to service length in armed forces; and 10 years for disabled persons.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose self-attested copies of educational certificates, marks memos, registration certificates where applicable, caste certificate, study certificates from 4th to 10th class, PH or ex-serviceman certificates if claiming reservation, one passport-size photograph pasted on the application, and an acknowledgment card.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode and last date of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in person or through registered post at UPHC Indira Nagar Colony near rice Godown, Ayushman Arogya Mandir Sanga Reddy HQ -502001 by 22 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. How are candidates selected for the Multi Purpose Worker post?
faq.answer: For the Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) post, 90 marks are allotted for a written test conducted by the concerned authorities, and 10 marks are awarded for age weightage.
